threads.body: [Config] Renovate's RE2 engine rejects this [lookbehind](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/34d4f5ee1e339cb0a1d690b48fb4df963238fc41/lib/modules/platform/github/massage-markdown-links.ts#L12-L17) and the [backreferences](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/34d4f5ee1e339cb0a1d690b48fb4df963238fc41/lib/modules/manager/custom/regex/readme.md#L100-L100) at line 531. These patterns therefore cannot discover or digest-pin the six shared images, and automated latest-runtime updates stop working. Replace the lookbehind with `\b` and the backreferences with independent `\d+` matches; the existing replacement template keeps the latest-version fields synchronized.

@copilot Simplify this PR directly on its existing same-repository head branch `copilot/renovate-java-runtime-images`, preserving the extraction and latest-JDK fixes delivered in `025bea2a`. Keep the branch assigned by GitHub Copilot cloud agent; do not rename it or create a replacement branch. If the platform assigns a follow-up branch, keep that branch. Do not request an additional PR or dispatch other tasks.

Move the six shared Jib runtime references from `smoke-tests/images/java-runtime-images.properties` into root `gradle.properties`, using descriptive keys such as `smokeTestJavaImage8` for fixed majors and a separate explicit latest-role key. Remove the extra properties file and the five repeated `Properties` imports/file loaders in grpc, play, quarkus, security-manager, and spring-boot builds. Use Gradle Provider property lookup, for example `providers.gradleProperty("smokeTestJavaImage$targetJDK").get()` for a fixed entry. Preserve the moving-latest selection as well: both reusable build/publish workflows must derive the selected major from the same latest image reference, and all consumers must resolve that matching image after a future feature release. Keep a clear failure for unsupported majors rather than silently selecting a different runtime. Retain the current defaults and Play compiler cap.

Consolidate compatible runtime-image regex managers in `.github/renovate.json5` rather than duplicating extraction and replacement logic for quoted Java/Gradle literals and fixed properties. Keep a dedicated moving-latest manager if necessary for its distinct dependency identity and update policy. Use only Renovate RE2-supported syntax and avoid duplicate extraction, including the latest property. Remove redundant `pinDigests: true` package rules already supplied for the Docker datasource by the existing `config:best-practices` preset. Combine the moving-latest package rules where their matching/semantics permit, but retain its explicit major-update enablement and LTS-filter override.

Update all ten PR-build/main-publish workflow path filters to root `gradle.properties`, and update both reusable workflows' latest-image reads to that source. Broader rebuilds for unrelated root-property changes are an accepted tradeoff. Preserve all existing image tags and digests, fixed test majors, runtime variants, historical fixtures, the separate moving-latest identity, and branch-specific compatibility. Do not depend on the independent Temurin comparator PR or change unrelated Java policies.

Validate with the actual Renovate config validator, RE2 extractor and update/replacement engine, not just native JavaScript/Python regex. Confirm the six shared references are each extracted exactly once, ordinary quoted literals remain discovered, historical fixtures are untouched, and initial digest pinning, digest refresh, and a next non-LTS feature-major update remain extractable and select/publish matching runtime majors. Run narrow relevant Gradle/configuration checks for the five consumers and inspect build/publish trigger wiring; report environmental limits honestly. Keep the simplification smaller than the existing implementation and avoid unrelated refactors.

@copilot Simplify this PR to a Renovate-config-only change, directly on its existing same-repository head branch `copilot/renovate-java-runtime-images`. Keep the branch assigned by GitHub Copilot cloud agent; do not rename it or create a replacement branch. Keep any platform-assigned follow-up branch if GitHub creates one. Do not request an additional PR or dispatch other tasks.

Decision: do not digest-pin or centrally manage the five Jib base images. On `main`, the Jib builds already use floating `eclipse-temurin:$targetJDK` tags, and the latest JDK used by the image workflows is already Renovate-managed through `LATEST_JAVA_VERSION: 27 # renovate(java-version)`. The shared `gradle.properties` map, Gradle selection logic, `eclipse-temurin-latest` alias, workflow parsing and path filters exist only to pin those Jib images, which is not worth the complexity.

Required changes: (1) Revert these files to exactly their `main` content: root `gradle.properties`; `smoke-tests/images/{grpc,play,quarkus,security-manager,spring-boot}/build.gradle.kts`; `.github/workflows/reusable-pr-smoke-test-images.yml`; `.github/workflows/reusable-publish-smoke-test-images.yml`; and the ten `.github/workflows/{pr,publish}-smoke-test-{grpc,play,quarkus,security-manager,spring-boot}-images.yml` callers. After this, the PR diff must touch only `.github/renovate.json5`. (2) In `.github/renovate.json5`, remove both `eclipse-temurin-latest` package rules and the dedicated `smokeTestJavaImageLatest` custom manager. (3) Keep `ibmjava` in the existing rule that disables major updates for `eclipse-temurin`. (4) Reduce the docker custom regex manager to only the quoted-literal case: `managerFilePatterns` `**/build.gradle.kts` and `**/*.java` (drop `gradle.properties`); a single matchString `"(?<depName>eclipse-temurin|ibm-semeru-runtimes|ibmjava):(?<currentValue>(?:open-)?\d[\w.-]*)(?:@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[0-9a-f]+))?"`; and `autoReplaceStringTemplate` `"{{{depName}}}:{{{newValue}}}{{#if newDigest}}@{{{newDigest}}}{{/if}}"` with no `depType` conditionals. Remove the now-stale comment about preserving the fixed property key. Keep the patterns RE2-compatible (no lookbehind or backreferences).

Acceptance criteria: `gh pr diff`-equivalent diff against `main` changes only `.github/renovate.json5`; Renovate config validates (e.g. `npx --yes --package renovate renovate-config-validator .github/renovate.json5`); a Renovate dry run or equivalent extraction check shows the quoted Java/Gradle runtime literals are discovered (tag-only and digest-pinned), Jib's interpolated `"eclipse-temurin:$targetJDK"` is not matched, and no `eclipse-temurin-latest` dependency remains. Report the checks you ran and any environmental limits.
